title: Wildly Fermented Jamaican Lamb Wrap
description: A paleo-friendly Jamaican dish featuring fermented lamb, wrapped in a corn husk with naan bread, reduced to perfection
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the lamb shoulder with allspice, thyme, garlic, and ginger
Wrap the lamb shoulder in corn husks and ferment for 24 hours
Grill the fermented lamb shoulder over medium heat for 10 minutes per side
Warm the naan bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes
Assemble the wrap by slicing the lamb and placing it in the naan bread with diced scotch bonnet peppers
Drizzle the wrap with coconut oil and serve immediately
Reduce the sauce from the lamb by cooking it over high heat for 5 minutes
Serve the wrap with the reduced sauce spooned over the top
